strings.description: Reads Abaqus input files (.inp) into the model; keywords the model does not hold are kept as they are.
strings.error.badEncoding: The file cannot be read as {encoding}.
strings.error.badGenerate: {keyword}, GENERATE: expected “first, last[, step]” with first ≤ last and a positive step.
strings.error.dataBeforeKeyword: A data line before the first keyword.
strings.error.incompleteElement: Element {element} of type {type} needs {count} nodes, the data ends earlier.
strings.error.syntax: {keyword}: the data line has too few values.
strings.error.tooManyNodes: Element {element} of type {type} has more than {count} nodes.
strings.error.unknownEncoding: Unknown encoding “{encoding}”: expected auto, utf-8, windows-1251, windows-1252 or latin-1.
strings.error.unknownNode: Element {element} refers to node {node}, which is not defined.
strings.error.unknownPart: *INSTANCE refers to the part “{part}”, which is not defined.
strings.error.unsupportedKeyword: {keyword} is not supported: without it the mesh would be wrong.
strings.error.unsupportedParameter: {keyword}: {parameter} is not supported: without it the mesh would be wrong.
strings.input.heading: Heading
strings.keyword.index.description: Number of the keyword in the file, included files spliced in, from 0.
strings.keyword.text.description: The keyword line and its data lines as in the file, without comments.
strings.name: Abaqus Formats
strings.problem.dependsOnPassthrough: {keyword}: “{name}” is kept without interpretation, and so is this line.
strings.problem.elementType: Elements {type} are read as {shape}: the model keeps the shape and the section; the type is kept for export.
strings.problem.emptyTarget: “{name}” acts on nothing: its set has no nodes or elements in the model.
strings.problem.encodingFallback: The file is not in UTF-8 and is read as {encoding}.
strings.problem.mixedIntegration: The set “{set}” has elements with full and reduced integration; for its section it is split into “{full}” and “{reduced}”.
strings.problem.nlgeom: Step “{step}”: NLGEOM is ignored, the step is linear.
strings.problem.renamedSet: The assembly set “{set}” on “{mesh}” is named “{name}”: the part has a set of that name.
strings.problem.sectionFamily: {keyword} on “{set}”: elements {type} do not take this kind of section.
strings.problem.temperatureDependent: {keyword} of material “{material}”: values by temperature are not supported, kept without interpretation.

problem.undefinedMembers.one: The set “{set}” on “{mesh}”: {count} label is not defined and is left out.
problem.undefinedMembers.other: The set “{set}” on “{mesh}”: {count} labels are not defined and are left out.

strings.problem.units: Abaqus input has no units: the values are taken in the units of the model, without conversion.
strings.problem.unknownReference: {keyword}: “{name}” is not defined; kept without interpretation.
strings.problem.unsupportedElementType: Elements {type} are not supported and are kept without interpretation.

problem.unsupportedLines.one: {keyword}: {count} data line is not supported and is kept without interpretation.
problem.unsupportedLines.other: {keyword}: {count} data lines are not supported and are kept without interpretation.

strings.problem.unsupportedParameter: {keyword}: the parameter {parameter} is not supported, the keyword is kept without interpretation.
strings.problem.unsupportedStep: Step “{step}” ({procedure}) is not a linear static step and is kept without interpretation.
strings.problem.unsupportedSurface: The surface “{name}” ({type}) is not supported and is kept without interpretation.
strings.problem.unsupportedVariables: {keyword}: the variables {variables} are kept without interpretation.
strings.types.blocks.description: The Abaqus element type of each block of the mesh, for export.
